name: Tuvalu Vaka Cable - Funafuti landing / provisional landing-station production environment
developer: Government of Tuvalu / Tuvalu Telecommunications Corporation (TTC) / Google (Bulikula system) / SubCom; funded via AIFFP (~USD 56m / AUD 80m)
notes: Tuvalu's first international subsea cable: branch from Funafuti to Google's Bulikula system; landed 2024-12-12 (Submarine Networks) and officially launched 2025-10-24 in Funafuti (Pacific Island Times/Pacific eCommerce). Per TV methodology this is a cable-landing asset (asset_class: cable-landing/provisional-cable-landing), NOT a commercial colocation datacenter; Vaka has been operated provisionally from the TTC Funafuti facility since Oct 2025 pending the formal landing-station production environment (JICA 2026 survey A-grade). AIFFP lists status Signed and Announced; full formal CLS/commissioning status to recheck.

name: TTC Funafuti server room / network core (provisional Vaka production environment)
notes: JICA 2026 survey (A) describes TTC's single-story building in Funafuti/Vaiaku containing a server room; Vaka cable runs provisionally from this facility (from 2025-10) before the planned micro data center is delivered. Asset class: telco-server-room / network-core. This is a telecom core/server room, not a commercial colocation datacenter (no customer-facing colo/racks marketed). TTC official site (tuvalutelecom.tv) confirms operator identity, Vaiaku/Funafuti address and fixed/mobile/internet services.

name: TTC adjacent micro data center (landing-station production environment)
developer: Tuvalu Telecommunications Corporation (TTC); IIJ reportedly engaged in earlier government micro-DC discussions (vendor history only)
notes: Per JICA 2026 survey (A-grade primary), a micro data center is planned adjacent to the TTC Funafuti facility for the Vaka landing-station production environment; equipment was in transit as of 2025-09 and arrival/commissioning is unconfirmed. Asset class: micro-dc (government/TTC micro facility), status: in transit/planned - do not treat as an operational DC until a newer source confirms delivery/commissioning. This is the closest thing to a datacenter project in Tuvalu; capacity unknown.

name: Starlink community gateway / ground station at TTC premises
notes: JICA 2026 survey (A) confirms a Starlink ground-station/community gateway installed at the TTC Funafuti premises; TTC official site (2025-03 onward) markets Starlink Priority Plans. Asset class: satellite-gateway - satellite access infrastructure, NOT a datacenter (no colo/hosting).

name: ATAL Networks 'Funafuti dedicated data center' (unverified marketing claim)
notes: Hosting-marketing page claiming a 'dedicated data center' in Funafuti with Tier III claims; identical templated pages exist for Apia (Samoa), Nuku'alofa (Tonga) and Kingstown (St Vincent) on the same site, and no verifiable in-country facility, TCRA-like licence or local operator evidence exists. Per TV methodology offshore/marketing hosting is not an in-country facility (not_dc_reason: marketing/offshore hosting, no corroborating A/B source). Recorded as U-grade lead only; NOT counted as a confirmed datacenter.
